Update or remove the references promptly; it need not block an unrelated merge.

The permission drift carries the highest agent-risk of these three: **0.52**, versus **0.48** and **0.44**. More importantly, it gives an agent three plausible but conflicting authorization models across three sources. An agent could confidently update only one and create a real access-control regression. The other findings mainly risk duplicated implementation or broken documentation.
